alt: 原本準備完成的活動，卻因臨時多加一項要求，引出新的麻煩，反而還不能開始。
scene_prompt: 節外生枝：現代原創成年小組活動本已整理妥當、作品安全擺好，主角臨時硬要再加一個大佈景，把原先通道堵住、電燈被遮而引出額外麻煩，其他人意外困擾，左上小淡回憶原先已可順利開始的簡單場地。重點原事情外又生事端，不是正常必要規劃、好意小修順利或樹木分枝字面。無字、數字、品牌、危險電線、傷亡或責怪群體。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Where people appear, give each anatomically coherent bodies with exactly two arms and natural hands. Point every speech bubble tail to its speaker and keep inset scenes clearly separated from physical surroundings. Scene:
